'''Lance Squadron''' was a [[Walker/Legends|walker]]-equipped squadron that was part of the [[Order of Revan]] forces during [[3637 BBY]]. Lance Squadron Walkers patrolled the area around Revanite encampments on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lance Squadron Walkers appear in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]]. Destroying all walkers is required to obtain an achievement.
